pages.title: Automation
pages.text: Many Hexalia systems can be automated using redstone and item transport, allowing for efficient and scalable setups.

pages.title: Enchanted Plants
pages.text: Enchanted Plants can be activated using a Hex Focus through a Dispenser. Certain plants can also be fed automatically using items.$(br2)$(li)Astrylis accepts Celestial Crystals$(li)Lourdes accepts Lotus Blossoms

pages.title: Inventory Automation
pages.text: All blocks with inventories support item insertion and extraction, allowing integration with hoppers and other transport systems.$(br2)$(li)Small Cauldron$(li)Censer$(li)Ritual Brazier$(li)Ritual Table$(li)Nesting Block$(li)Shelf$(li)Mortar and Pestle

pages.title: Redstone
pages.text: The Mortar and Pestle can be triggered using redstone, allowing its processing to be automated.

pages.title: On Setup
pages.text: Automation in Hexalia combines item movement, activation, and processing. With the right setup, many systems can run without direct interaction.
